posts.preview: As a parliamentarian deployed through the SWAPO Party and nominated by the National Union of Namibian Workers (NUNW) to represent the interests of workers, it is my responsibility to remain closely engaged with the people I serve. Regular interaction with NUNW’s grassroots structures enables me to better understand...
* Representing workers and the broader public by raising issues that affect their lives and advocating for their interests in Parliament
* Participating in parliamentary committees to examine matters of public interest, review legislation, and oversee the work of government ministries and agencies
* Engaging with the public by consulting citizens, listening to their concerns, receiving their views and petitions, and communicating parliamentary decisions and policies
